title: Glyph workflow definition
description: A complete Glyph workflow written as YAML. Keys left out take the documented default. The schema checks structure, types, and allowed values; readiness (a step without a prompt, a model that is no longer available) is reported by the workflow validator after the document is applied.

name.description: Workflow name shown in the panel.

description.description: Free text describing what the workflow does.

fail_fast.description: When true, the first failed step cancels every step that is still queued or running.

defaults.description: Values inherited by every Pi step that omits the same key. Applied at import time; each step is stored with its resolved value.

inputs.description: Workflow inputs keyed by name. Map order is the display order. A scalar value declares a constant: stored once, never asked at run time. An object declares an input asked at run time unless it carries a value.

texts.description: Shared texts keyed by name: written once and referenced from steps' prompt, context and expect with {ref: name}. A scalar value is the text body; an object adds a description.

schedule.description: Recurring execution. Present means the workflow has a schedule; absent means it has none.

cron.description: Five-field cron expression, for example "0 9 * * 1" for Mondays at 09:00.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the cron expression is evaluated in, for example America/Sao_Paulo.

enabled.description: Whether scheduled runs are dispatched once the workflow is active.

description.description: Human wording of the recurrence shown next to the cron expression.

values.description: Values the schedule supplies for workflow inputs that are asked at run time, keyed by input name.

steps.description: Steps in display order. Dependencies come from step inputs, never from list order.

scalar.description: A literal value. Numbers and booleans are stored as text.

inputName.description: Starts with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, and underscores.

stepInputName.description: Starts with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, underscores, and hyphens. Referenced in prompts as {{name}}.

model.description: Model in provider/model_id form, for example openai/gpt-5. Must be in Glyph's available-model catalog for the workflow to run.

tools.description: Tool keys the step may use, from the server catalog: read, bash, edit, write.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Only valid for models whose capabilities include temperature.

format.description: File format of the step output. markdown is free text.

description.description: Shown when the value is asked for.

value.description: Stored value. With ask true it is the default offered at run time; with ask false it is the constant.

required.description: Whether a run needs a value for this input.

ask.description: Ask for the value at run time. Defaults to true when no value is given and false when one is.

sharedText.description: A shared text with an optional description.

description.description: Shown above the text in the editor.

body.description: The text. {{name}} tokens are filled per step by the referencing step's vars, then by step inputs and workflow values at run time.

textField.description: A prompt / context / expect field: inline text, or a reference to a shared text with per-step variable values.

ref.description: Key of a shared text in texts:.

vars.description: Values for the {{name}} tokens in the text, keyed by token name. Scalars are stored as text; unfilled tokens fall back to step inputs and workflow values at run time.

stepInput.description: Where a step input gets its value. A bare name refers to a step (its output) or to a workflow input; the object form adds required and description. An object without from is an unconnected input.

from.description: Name of the source step or workflow input. A name that exists as both is an error.

required.description: When true the step is skipped if the source produced nothing.

description.description: What this input carries; shown in the step inspector.

id.description: Stable identity written by export. Optional by hand. When applying onto an existing workflow it must match one of its steps; when creating a new workflow it is ignored.

name.description: Step name, unique within the workflow ignoring case. Used to match existing steps when id is absent and to reference the step from other steps' inputs.

kind.description: pi runs a prompt through the Pi agent. helper is deterministic: it gathers its inputs into one structured output without calling a model.

description.description: Notes for the author; not sent to the model.

prompt.description: Instructions for the agent. {{name}} interpolates a workflow value or one of this step's inputs.

context.description: Additional context appended to the prompt. Supports the same {{name}} tokens.

expect.description: What a correct output looks like. Used to check and guide the agent. Not interpolated at run time: a shared-text reference must fill every {{name}} token itself.

output.description: Name of the output this step exposes. Defaults to the step name.

output_description.description: What downstream steps can expect in the output.

allow_failure.description: When true a failure does not skip downstream steps; they run with this input absent.

inputs.description: Step inputs keyed by name. Map order is the display order.
